description: Replace mod-based sharding with a consistent-hash ring (virtual nodes) so removing one node only remaps that node's own keys
prompts: HashRing.java's getNode picks a node with `Math.floorMod(key.hashCode(), nodes.size())` - removing or adding any node reshuffles almost every key. Implement a real consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes: the constructor takes (List<String> nodes, int replicas) and places `replicas` virtual points per physical node around a ring, hashed via MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5") over (node + ":" + i) for each virtual point - do not use String.hashCode(), it's a weaker distribution and the point is to use a real hash. getNode(String key) hashes the key onto the ring and returns the node owning the next virtual point clockwise (wrapping around). addNode(String node) and removeNode(String node) update the ring in place.
name: add_java_consistent_hash_ring
